summary: Ramsey says Stanley Dance called Eddie the first of the cool tenors; Eddie takes it as a compliment.

blocks.x: Is that what Nick comes from? Numbers 522-3791. Pete Fountain and Eddie Miller are with us tonight. And we'll be taking your phone calls in just a few minutes. If you want to call and ask about music or the French Quarter, which Pete is an expert on, of course, because he helped build it. Oh, no.
